 Ted on Alt Goes Mainstream (EP.458) Sep 8, 2025

 Once in a while, I take a turn on the other side of the
microphone and share it on our feed when I’ve said something
different from what I have in the past. 
   
 I recently appeared on Michael Sidgmore’s Alt Goes Mainstream
podcast, which focuses on the intersection of private markets and
wealth management. Michael was the first guest on our Private
Wealth mini-series and asked me to share my lessons from that
mini-series on AGM when it concluded.  
   
 Our conversation covers David Swensen’s lasting legacy,
perspectives on private market interest from the wealth channel,
parallels of private equity and the hedge fund industry, behavioral
biases in manager selection, and the power of content in asset
management.  
   
 Please enjoy my turn on the other side of the microphone, with
Michael Sidgmore on the AGM podcast.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
